title: Add ensure_changelog and verifier scope rule; leave reader prompt alone
summary: Retry of jk8v without the reader.md line and without touching defaults.toml. Code in reading.rs adds CHANGELOG.md to change readings' deliverables (with a 'changelog' default citing BRIEF.md), and the verifier brief states that a changed file outside the deliverables list is the scope finding.

defaults_applied.how: All changes are Rust code plus docs.
New unit tests for ensure_changelog and the verifier brief scope text; cargo test and clippy must pass.
One focused change: the code rule, the brief text, tests, and two doc entries.
Scope is made a single statement (the deliverables list) instead of heuristics over criteria.
Doc entries state the why for an outside reader.
The changelog rule is enforced in code, not prose.

assumptions: The verifier brief's scope section is the 'Expected deliverables' part generated in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs; the producer may instead put the sentence in prompts/verifier.md if that is where verifier prose lives.
Since defaults.toml cannot change, the 'changelog' default is a synthesized defaults_applied entry (id 'changelog') written by code, not a new entry in defaults.toml.
The reader's 1800-token budget is untouched because reader.md is unchanged; the added brief text goes to the verifier, not the reader.
Edits to the existing 'Expected deliverables' heading text must not break existing briefs.rs tests.

acceptance_criteria.text: cargo test passes, including new tests: for a change reading with no CHANGELOG.md deliverable, build_reading adds a modify CHANGELOG.md deliverable and a 'changelog' defaults_applied entry whose text cites BRIEF.md's 'tagged releases and a changelog'.
cargo test covers that ensure_changelog adds nothing when CHANGELOG.md is already listed (no duplicate default or deliverable) and does nothing for non-change (study or declined) readings.
cargo test covers that the verifier brief contains a scope section saying a changed file outside the deliverables list is the scope finding, judged against the list and not against criterion wording.
ensure_changelog is a function in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs that does no text matching of acceptance criteria.
CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md each gain an entry describing the change and why (single statement of scope, no heuristics).
cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check are clean.

out_of_scope: any text matching over acceptance criteria
changes to admission or governance-file rules
